h: Turkish pundit questions Osimhen's man-of-the-match award in Galatasaray win over Lille
p: A Turkish football commentator has questioned why Victor Osimhen was named player of the match after Galatasaray beat Lille in the Champions League. The debate has divided fans, with many Nigerians defending the striker.
more: Galatasaray took the win in Europe's top club competition.
Osimhen has not responded to the comments.
